description: A green cloth-covered surface holds piles of colorful plastic beads, a black tape dispenser, and a dark cord necklace with a few beads already on it. The left hand steadies the cord near its end while the right hand pinches a small green bead, guides it onto the cord, then slides it down and briefly pulls the cord upward to unthread or adjust the bead’s position, ending with the bead no longer at the cord tip.
